excerpt: Table 1 lists mindfulness measures with different contexts and factors: FMI from Buddhist theory with one general factor; MAAS from self-determination theory with attentiveness and awareness; KIMS from dialectical behavior therapy with observing, describing, awareness, and acceptance; FFMQ with nonreactivity, observing, awareness, describing, and nonjudging; TMS with curiosity and decentering; CAMS-R with attention, present focus, awareness, and acceptance.
overview: The table functions as concrete evidence that mindfulness is not measured as a single settled construct. Multiple instruments use different theoretical backgrounds and factor structures, making it risky to treat questionnaire scores as interchangeable evidence for a common mental capacity or intervention mechanism.
title: Divergent Mindfulness Measures
